messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: tagged release `v1.11.2-hotfix-fix-kvcache` to prod-us-west-2. Commit: `a3f9d2c`. Rolling out canary (3%). Change window: 2026-06-04 03:00-03:30 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/v1.11.2-hotfix :rocket:
aria: Ack. Noting this includes the KV cache edge-case fix we saw in staging logs. Watching metrics and logs.
sanjay: I'm going to pin model-serving pool to the previous runtime on a subset if we see tokenization regressions. Plan: canary -> 10% after 5m success -> 50% after 15m -> full.
emma_oncall: Oncall here, I'll keep pager escalation ready. If latency P95 jumps >200ms or error-rate >1.5% we'll abort.
jun: FYI, I've pushed a quick rollback script to infra-tools: `scripts/rollbacks/rollback-to-v1.11.1.sh` if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary update: 3% -> success. Observed: request rate normal, no increase in 5xx, avg latency +8ms. Proceeding to 10% in 2 minutes.
aria: Seeing a few decoding warnings in transformer logs at canary pods: `WARN tokenization: fallback to byte-level`. Not sure if user-visible yet.
sanjay: Can you paste a snippet of the log?
aria: ```
2026-06-04T03:07:12Z app-kw-3 tokenization WARN fallback to byte-level for input id=34fd...
2026-06-04T03:07:14Z app-kw-3 model WARN kv-cache-miss idx=128
```
sanjay: Hm. kv-cache-miss spam could increase cost but not correctness. Let's hold 10% for extra 10m and re-evaluate. Move to 10% but no further until we confirm.
emma_oncall: Agreed. I'll extend the hold. If no user errors in 10m we can proceed.
deploy-bot: Canary update: scaled to 10% (held by manual policy). Next automatic step is blocked by hold.
aria: After 6m of 10% traffic: error-rate 0.02%, latency stable, warnings persist but not user-facing. I recommend proceed to 50% for broader validation.
sanjay: Going to run a quick A/B check on a prompt set we use for tokenization regression detection (see link: https://redwood-internal/evals/tokenization-suite).
jun: Ran the evaluation locally against v1.11.2-hotfix and v1.11.1 — small delta only in a few edge prompts, mostly benign.
sanjay: Results look safe. Proceed to 50% canary.
deploy-bot: Rolling out to 50% now.
aria: Monitoring. Noticing one spike in latency at 03:22:11 UTC on app-kw-7 pod (P95 up by 180ms for a minute). No correlated errors.
emma_oncall: Spike noted. Keep an eye for recurrence. If we see another spike or user-impacting error we rollback.
aria: Another smaller spike at 03:24:05. Still no user 5xxs. I'm worried these could correlate to the kv-cache-miss frequency.
sanjay: Given two spikes and the kv-cache warnings, propose we halt the rollout to 50% and roll back the affected subset of nodes while we investigate. Recommend rollback of the recent tag from app-kw-6 and app-kw-7.
une: Wait, typo — jun: I'll initiate targeted rollback on those pods and mark the release as paused in the console. Running: `infractl rollback --target app-kw-6,app-kw-7 --to v1.11.1`
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: target pods app-kw-6, app-kw-7. Status: in-progress.
aria: After rollback of app-kw-6 and app-kw-7, metrics back to baseline, no further spikes for 4m.
emma_oncall: Good catch. sanjay, let's pin the runtime on those pools to v1.11.1 until we root-cause the kv-cache miss pattern.
sanjay: Done. I've pinned pool `model-kw-prod` (nodes app-kw-6,7) to v1.11.1 and set a label `hold-hotfix-investigate=true`.
jun: I'll open a postmortem ticket with logs and the eval diff: https://redwood-internal/tickets/INC-2026-411. Tagging @infra and @ml-runtime.
aria: For now we won't promote to 100%. I'll re-run the tokenization eval after deeper logging is added to the kv-cache.
deploy-bot: Deployment status: PARTIAL — tagged release `v1.11.2-hotfix-fix-kvcache` partially applied (50% blocked, targeted rollback on subset). See deployment console: https://console.redwood/deploys/1968467890.
emma_oncall: Thanks all. I'll update the incident channel if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
